The scores for these pathways are consistent, indicating a plausible biological link. The mechanisms underlying this relationship may involve the anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory properties of Prednisone, which are known to influence cancer progression and immune system function. However, the evidence is limited to the indications provided in the dataset, and there is no direct evidence of a causal relationship between Triamcinolone and Lymphosarcoma.
